description: Creating /tasks/{id} requires title:string, done:bool, ownerId==auth.uid; owner-only read.
prompt: Write Firestore rules so creating a document at /tasks/{taskId} is allowed only for signed-in users when the new document has a string 'title', a boolean 'done', and an 'ownerId' equal to request.auth.uid. Deny creates that are missing any of these fields or whose ownerId is not the caller. Reads of a task are allowed only to its owner.
